consumer_warning.title: Scam alert: fake Nairobi Sneaker Vault page
consumer_warning.body:
Fake page alert: @nairobisneakervau1t is not Nairobi Sneaker Vault.
Don't send money to 0711 222 333.
Pay only via Buy Goods Till 543210 (NAIROBI SNEAKER VAULT) through @nairobisneakervault.
Please report the fake page and share this message with friends and family.

platform_takedown.body:
I am reporting an account that is impersonating my business, Nairobi Sneaker Vault.

Impersonating account: @nairobisneakervau1t (https://instagram.com/nairobisneakervau1t)
Our official account(s): @nairobisneakervault (instagram), @nairobisneakervault (tiktok)

Evidence recorded by Halisi (first seen 2026-09-26):
- Profile picture: perceptual-hash distance 10/64 from our registered logo (visual similarity 70%).
- Name/handle similarity to our official account: 100%.
- It asks customers to pay 0711 222 333, which is not registered to our business.
- Its name imitates Nairobi Sneaker Vault's official account @nairobisneakervault.
- Asks for payment to a personal number, not Nairobi Sneaker Vault's official payment channel.
- Uses a logo 70% similar to Nairobi Sneaker Vault's.
- Uses pressure phrases common in scams: 'pochi la biashara', 'delivery countrywide'.

Please remove this account. It uses our identity to take payments from our customers.
